scenarios.notes: Two deposits of 1,000 USDC at par. The valuation doubles, the time-weighted and money-weighted returns are exactly zero.

10 FXA and 100 USDC, then a 500 USDC deposit at noon on day two between a rise and a fall. End value 699 against a start of 200, yet the time-weighted return is +3.37% and the money-weighted return is −0.31%.
A 50/40/10 recipe; XSB splits 2:1 on day two (multiplier 1 → 2, price 50 → 25). The split changes nothing; the value moves only with prices.
The same recipe with no XSB observation on day two: that point is stale, the chain breaks and no return is reported although the end value is known.
FXA's last observation is 30 hours old at the end: the end point is incomplete and stale, so nothing is reported for the window.
Everything withdrawn on day two and 50 deposited on day three: the chain cannot pass through a zero valuation, so the time-weighted return is not reported; Modified Dietz is zero.
A strategy instance buys 10 FXA for 100 USDC, sells 4 at 12 (proceeds 48, FIFO cost 40) and holds 6 at 11. Price path 10 → 12 → 11 gives +10% time-weighted; the sale is a withdrawal, not a loss.
Forty days of daily observations rising 0.10 a day: rankable over 30 days.
Forty days rising 0.05 a day: rankable, behind model-long-a.
